summary.text: Andrew Garrett represents House District 22 in the Hawaii House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Before that Garrett was Deputy Director of the state Department of Human Resources Development under Governor David Ige, and held executive roles with the Healthcare Association of Hawaii and the Hawaii Institute for Public Affairs.

Garrett was born and raised at Camp Zama, Japan, moved to Mililani at age 11, and holds a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree in public administration from the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa.
